def fast_power(base, exp):
    res = 1
    for _ in range(exp):
        res = (res * base) % MOD_CONST
    return res

def calculate(p, k):
    if k <= 1:
        return fast_power(p, p - 1 + k)
    cycle_length = 1
    val = k
    while val != 1:
        val = (val * k) % p
        cycle_length += 1
    return fast_power(p, (p - 1) // cycle_length)

MOD_CONST = 1000000007

p, k = map(int, input().split())
print(calculate(p, k))
